name: SnapSections
description: Full-height sections inside their own viewport that advance exactly one section per wheel or trackpad gesture with an eased snap animation, plus clickable dot navigation and PageUp/PageDown/Arrow/Space/Home/End keys; each section's content rises in as it becomes active.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" whose label explains the Page Up/Page Down controls; PageDown/ArrowDown/Space go forward, PageUp/ArrowUp/Shift+Space go back, Home/End jump to the ends, all with a 2px :focus-visible outline. Each section is a labelled <section> ("2 of 4: Organize") with a real heading. The dot navigation is a <nav aria-label="Sections"> of buttons with descriptive aria-labels and aria-current on the active one. A fresh wheel gesture past the first or last section is not intercepted, so the page keeps scrolling; touch uses native CSS scroll-snap. Under prefers-reduced-motion (or smooth=false) the wheel is not intercepted, snapping is native CSS scroll-snap and content transitions are removed.

propsApi.name: sections
propsApi.description: Section titles, one full-height section per item.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for the glow orb (hue-shifted per section), kicker and active dot.

propsApi.name: ease
propsApi.description: Easing curve of the snap animation.

propsApi.name: dotsPosition
propsApi.description: Side the dot navigation sits on.

propsApi.name: threshold
propsApi.description: Accumulated wheel delta in px needed to trigger a snap; raise it to ignore tiny trackpad nudges.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Animate snaps with easing; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native CSS scroll-snap.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the viewport (and of each section) in px; width is always 100%.

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: onSectionChange
propsApi.description: Called with the new index whenever the active section changes.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
